# read_cif_string { #mofography.data.read_cif_string }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Parse in-memory CIF text; file paths should use read_cif_to_ase instead. Use `read_cif_to_ase` instead.

```python
data.read_cif_string(cif)
```

Parse a CIF string into an ASE Atoms object, or the string ``NaN`` on failure.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description              | Default    |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|------------|
| cif    |        | The CIF file as a string | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description           |
|--------|--------|-----------------------|
|        |        | the ASE atoms object. |
